## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix how `--json` is parsed before merging: it takes the next argument as its path even when that argument is another flag, so `--json --junit out.xml` fails.

## Changes
The pull request adds a `--json` option to `parse_args` that takes an optional path and defaults to `results.json`. It also adds a `write_reports` helper that writes each parsed report to its destination, and adds `tests/test_cli.py`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:15 — correctness — Don't consume a following flag as the `--json` path — Input `["--json", "--junit", "out.xml"]` sets `json` to `"--junit"`, then raises `ValueError("unknown option: out.xml")`. Line 15 checks only `i + 1 < len(args)`; it lacks the `startswith("--")` check that `--junit` uses on line 7. — Users can't use the default JSON destination with a `--junit` flag after it, which is the combination the PR description advertises. — Fix: Treat the next argument as the path only when it exists and doesn't start with `--`, as line 7 does, and add a case to `test_json_default_and_explicit_path`.
